result.reason: The cap is mutual, uses the required greater-of formulation, includes the specified claims, and excludes Company’s payment obligations from the cap. However, the definition states that Excluded Claims are not subject to “any limitation of liability,” which also overrides subsection (b)’s exclusion of indirect and consequential damages. The playbook requires that exclusion to remain mutual; the carve-outs need only be uncapped. This wording therefore expands recoverable damages and alters the original damages allocation more than necessary. The lookback also runs from the event giving rise to the claim rather than from the claim, as specified in the preferred position.
